name: P-JiT 21K (2B pixel-space text-to-image model, open weights)
summary: Linum's 2.18B-parameter text-to-image DiT that works directly in pixel space (no VAE), trained from scratch on 660M samples for about $21K of compute. Apache-2.0 weights plus inference code and prompt upsampler. Research checkpoint: cannot render text/posters, weak on full bodies and crowds; a useful base for efficient-training experiments and fine-tunes.

access.notes: Not gated. Needs Qwen3.5-4B text encoder (separate download, own license). Optional prompt upsampler calls Claude via OpenRouter (API key); --no_upsample keeps prompts local. Research checkpoint, rough edges.

procedure: git clone https://github.com/Linum-AI/pjit-21k && cd pjit-21k && pip install -e .
Weights (model.safetensors, 8.7 GB fp32) download from Hugging Face Linum-AI/pjit-21k
Run python generate.py --no_upsample --prompt "<50-80 word caption>" (NVIDIA GPU)

stats.count: 2.18B params; 46 HF likes, 49 GitHub stars at check

verdict.why: Genuine open weights under Apache-2.0 (card + repo LICENSE read), ungated 8.7 GB file answers 200, reproducible samples. Research-grade quality and no text rendering limit production use.
